title: Gemma Gem: Local Browser AI Agent via WebGPU
summary: A fully autonomous AI agent that runs locally in the browser using hardware-accelerated WebGPU and Google's Gemma 4 models. It performs web navigation, form filling, and JS execution without requiring external API keys or cloud connections.
research_notes: Privacy-first architecture using Chrome extensions; requires a WebGPU-compatible browser.

evolution.summary: Leverages the Gemma 4 model family released in April 2026, which introduced 'Thinking Mode' and massive improvements in agentic reasoning. The project currently supports quantized E2B and E4B models for optimized on-device performance.
